title: Day 4 — Loops: Bar-Bar Code Repeat Karyo
preamble: Aaj hum loops ke baare mein janenge. Loops ka istemal tab hota hai jab aapko ek hi code block ko baar-baar chalana ho. `for`, `while`, aur `do-while` loops ke zariye aap repetitive tasks automate kar sakte hain. `for` loop tab best hai jab aapko pehle se pata ho kitni baar repeat karna hai, jabki `while` loop tab use hota hai jab condition pehle se maloom na ho ya jab tak condition true rahe tab tak chalana ho.

sections.label: Concept
sections.content: Loops programming mein ek aisa tareeqa hai jisse aap ek hi code block ko multiple times execute kar sakte hain. Teeno types ke loops (`for`, `while`, `do-while`) alag-alag scenarios ke liye use kiye jaate hain. `for` loop tab best hota hai jab aapko pehle se pata ho ke kitni baar repeat karna hai, jaise kisi array ke har element ko process karna. `while` loop tab use hota hai jab aapko condition check karni ho aur jab tak wo condition true rahe tab tak loop chalana ho. `do-while` loop bhi `while` loop ki tarah hota hai, lekin isme pehle code block execute hota hai phir condition check hoti hai, isliye yeh kam az kam ek bar toh zaroor chalta hai.

sections.label: Example
Practice
sections.content:
Aik program likho jo user thi aik number input ley aur uske table (1 thi 10 tak) ko print karyo. Iske liye `while` loop use karyo. Example:

Input: 5
Output:
5 x 1 = 5
5 x 2 = 10
...
5 x 10 = 50

sections.label: Mini Project
sections.content:
Aik simple calculator banayo jo user thi do numbers aur aik operator (`+`, `-`, `*`, `/`) input ley, phir loop ke zariye result calculate karyo aur bar-baar chalne dey jab tak user "exit" type na karyo. Program ko is tarah design karyo:

1. User thi do numbers aur operator input ley.
2. Result calculate karyo aur display karyo.
3. User thi dobaar calculation karne ka poochho.
4. Agar user "exit" type karyo toh program khatam karyo.

Example:
Input: 5 + 3
Output: 8

Do you want to continue? (yes/no): yes

Input: 10 / 2
Output: 5

Do you want to continue? (yes/no): no

Program khatam ho gaya.
